title: Good Vibes on Main | A+ Location | 1 mi to DTNash
description:
Welcome to Good Vibes on Main—your East Nashville retreat filled with style, comfort, and charm. Just a half-mile to Five Points and 1.2 miles from Downtown, this fresh & modern condo is steps from local gems like Frothy Monkey, Butcher & Bee, and Lyra. Sip, shop, and stroll through the city with a Walk Score of 92. 

Whether you're here for the tunes, the eats, or just a good time—this is your place to vibe out in Music City.

Book a Pilates class at the studio located in the building! Book NOW

The space
Built in 2022, Good Vibes on Main Street blends modern style with everyday comfort. Chill out with central A/C or kick back on the private balcony—perfect for sunny hangs or winding down with your crew. Inside, you’ll find spa-inspired bathrooms with luxe finishes, lighted vanity mirrors, a walk-in shower with bench, and a tub/shower combo for soaking or quick rinses.

Cook up your favorites in the sleek open kitchen with stainless steel appliances and all your go-to tools. The cozy sectional is made for movie nights, and there are smart TVs in both bedrooms (each with a plush King bed!). You'll also enjoy in-unit laundry and free WiFi to keep things easy and connected.

-OUTDOOR SPACE-
The outdoor space consists of a communal roof top deck with views of the Downtown Skyline. 

-ESSENTIALS-
Parking is available under the building & on the street. 
Jolene on Main is equipped with high speed WiFi, heating and AC.

- HIGHLIGHTS-
 ♡ 6-minute drive to Broadway

 ♡ Outdoor dining and lounging areas
